reason: The only EUR to USD rate in the catalog was an ECB reference valid for 2026-10-09 alone, so any later quote needing a tool priced in EUR had no rate. Adds an open-ended quote FX under the CEO instruction of 2026-10-10 to use a prudential margin over spot.

record.note: Quote FX for costs priced in EUR: 1.20 USD per EUR, about 7% above the ECB reference of 1.1206 (2026-10-09), the same prudential margin the CEO set for the other quote FX. On the cost side the prudent direction is a higher rate. Not explicitly decided for EUR; a policy value, not a market observation.
